findings.title: SEED-13 consumer-side root cause: neither memory-awareness's skip list nor extractIntent has any machine-content guard or length cap — XML/markdown blobs >=15 chars pass straight through as recall intents, get logged raw, and ride the full hybrid recall (~12s budget)
causal_links: seed SEED-13 (<task-notification> XML blobs as recall intents) — this is the missing guard that lets them through
amplified-by D3c-03 (gitExpanded bypass skips even the meta-language stripping)
same gap in agent-recall-injector: extractIntent over a multi-KB agent prompt yields the whole prompt as --query argv (see D3c-01 telemetry sample)
findings.observe_how: The only skips before recall are: CLAUDE_AGENT_ID set, prompt<15 chars, leading '/'. META_PATTERNS in intent-extractor.ts strip only human meta-language ('can you', 'how do i', ...). A prompt beginning '<task-notification>' or '## Mode' passes both gates verbatim; intent is stored uncapped in memory-recall.jsonl (capped at 200 chars only at the injection surface) and in Braintrust metadata.intent.
findings.telemetry: Harvest: intent_pollution 24.6% (69/281 rows). Fix candidates: reject/strip intents starting with '<' or markdown-heading structure, cap intent length before logging/querying, and skip system-generated UserPromptSubmit events. Each polluted intent burns the full 12s hybrid (or 5s text-only) recall budget for a structurally unmatchable query.

notes: Headline: the WS-0.2 sanitization fix and the P1 bus-bias gating both hold end-to-end — the injection surfaces are clean. The real D3c story is that BOTH auxiliary recall paths are silently dead from the same bug class the file itself documents as already-fixed-once: (1) agent-recall's 3500ms timeout vs the 5000ms documented safe floor → 0/78 lifetime yield, meaning NO subagent has ever received recalled memory despite the hook firing at every spawn; (2) memory-awareness's local-memory spawn still uses the original 2000ms 'SIGKILLs every recall on Windows' timeout → 0/281 local contributions, so the Wave-3 dual-source merge has never merged. Both burn their full timeout as pure latency on hot paths. Separately, expandGitQuery's substring 'pr' match pollutes/replaces the recall query on a large fraction of ordinary English prompts and bypasses intent extraction entirely — a strong candidate contributor to the 27.4% hit-rate and 24.6% intent-pollution telemetry, alongside the missing machine-content guard (SEED-13). Note the irony chain: fixing D3c-02 without recalibrating LOCAL_SCORE_NORMALIZE (D3c-05) would re-introduce local-over-DB shadowing in hybrid mode — the exact failure Wave 3 was built to remove. All evidence quotes are verbatim from src files at the frozen working tree; log-derived statistics are confined to telemetry/observe_how fields (the harvest table under docs/reviews/ is excluded from evidence[] per the exclusion manifest).
